meta.title: Difficulty swallowing solid foods
meta.candidate_brief: You are assessing this patient in the rapid access endoscopy clinic. Take a focused history regarding their swallowing difficulties and screen for alarm features.

patient_script.opening_statement: Food keeps getting stuck when I swallow, especially meat.

if_asked.symptom_details: Solid foods, especially meat or bread, feel like they hang up in my chest and I have to sip water to get them down.
if_asked.timing: Started three months ago and has slowly worsened; now happens almost every meal.
if_asked.after_effects: Sometimes I regurgitate undigested food if I try to force it, which is embarrassing.
if_asked.exacerbating: Dry foods and eating quickly make it worse.
if_asked.relieving: Cutting food into small pieces and drinking warm tea helps.
if_asked.associated_symptoms: I've lost about 4 kilos unintentionally and have occasional heartburn but no vomiting or coughing when drinking.
if_asked.past_medical_history: History of long-standing heartburn and was told years ago I had Barrett's esophagus.
if_asked.medications: Take omeprazole 20mg once daily; sometimes forget evening dose when prescribed twice daily.
if_asked.allergies: Allergic to aspirin; it gives me hives.
if_asked.family_history: No esophageal cancer; mother had breast cancer.
if_asked.social_history: Former smoker (quit 5 years ago, 20 pack-year history), drinks a glass of wine most nights, works as a teacher, lives with husband.
if_asked.functional_status: Avoiding meals out and takes longer to finish meals, causing concern at work lunchtimes.

collateral.observer_note: Husband says she chews excessively and drinks lots of water to help food go down.

patient_script.emotional_tone: Mildly anxious, careful speech, occasional throat clearing

pc.one_liner: Solid foods feel like they get stuck partway down.

dh.recent_changes: GP suggested increasing to BD but patient inconsistently follows

sh.diet: Avoiding red meat and bread due to symptoms
sh.occupation_detail: Full-time teacher, eats in staff room

ice.concerns: Fear of cancer and choking in public

examiner_guidance.most_likely_diagnosis: Progressive peptic stricture secondary to chronic reflux
